broken_watch.title: Broken Pocket Watch
broken_watch.description: Stopped at 9:17 PM. The hands are jammed; looks like a physical struggle took place.

wine_glass.title: Stained Wine Glass
wine_glass.description: A glass containing red wine residue. Smells faintly of bitter almonds (cyanide).

medicine_bottle.title: Arthur's Pill Bottle
medicine_bottle.description: Prescription sleeping pills. Almost full. Arthur was supposed to take them nightly.
medicine_bottle.possible_uses: Ruling out natural causes or validating sleep schedules.

burned_letter.title: Charred Letter Fragment
burned_letter.description: A half-burned letter from Arthur to Victor Hayes. Reads: '...found the missing company assets. Tomorrow I will report you to the fraud squad. There is no escape, Victor.'

footprints.title: Muddy Footprints
footprints.description: Wet footprints near the outer window sill. Size 10. Too small for Arthur, too big for Eleanor.
footprints.possible_uses: Confirming presence of an outside intruder.

bank_transfer.title: Suspicious Bank Transfer Statement
bank_transfer.description: A private printout showing $5M transferred from Blackwood Industries to an offshore shell company owned by 'V.H.'

phone_logs.title: Arthur's Phone Logs
phone_logs.description: Call records from Arthur's mobile. At 9:45 PM he called Victor Hayes (duration: 12 seconds). At 9:50 PM he called Detective Harris (duration: 3 minutes, missed call).

security_footage.title: Gate Security Logs
security_footage.description: Digital gate log showing Victor's luxury sedan entering the estate grounds at 9:55 PM, and leaving at 10:15 PM.
security_footage.possible_uses: Breaking Victor's alibi of being home all night.

forged_signature.title: Art Sales Certificate
forged_signature.description: A certificate for an expensive watercolor painting, signed by Arthur. Under magnification, the handwriting seems slightly shaky. A expert might call it a forgery.

will_draft.title: Draft of New Will
will_draft.description: Arthur's hand-written draft of a new will, dated yesterday. It removes Daniel Blackwood and Victor Hayes entirely from his estate and leaves all shares to a charity.
will_draft.possible_uses: Proving motive for Daniel or business conflicts.

cyanide_vial.title: Small Glass Vial
cyanide_vial.description: A discarded vial with traces of potassium cyanide powder. Taped underneath the shelf in the butler's pantry.
cyanide_vial.possible_uses: Identifying the poison source (planted by Victor).

hallway_logs.title: Hallway Motion Sensor Log
hallway_logs.description: Logs record motion in the study hallway at 10:00 PM. Someone went toward the study. Fits James's route, or someone else.
